item.title: Kim Yong-nam, Yoo Ui-dong, and Cho Kuk in a 20% Range Tight Race… Unification to Decide Fate of Pyeongtaek B District (김용남·유의동·조국 20%대 박빙… 평택乙 운명 가를 단일화)
item.description:
Kim Yong-nam, Yoo Ui-dong, and Cho Kuk in a 20% Range Tight Race… Unification to Decide Fate of Pyeongtaek B District (김용남·유의동·조국 20%대 박빙… 평택乙 운명 가를 단일화)

In the by-elections for National Assembly seats held alongside the June 3 local elections, candidate unification has emerged as a key variable determining victory or defeat. Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek B and Busan North A were originally districts of the Democratic Party, but with candidates from the ruling party, opposition party, and even independents stepping forward, they are now competing in five-way and three-way races. Poll results have also shown that support rates for candidates are similar, making it difficult for anyone to guarantee victory. (6·3 지방선거와 함께 치러지는 국회의원 재·보궐선거에서 후보 단일화가 승패를 가를 변수로 떠올랐다. 경기 평택을과 부산 북갑은 원래 더불어민주당 지역구였지만 여야, 무소속 후보까지 나서면서 5자, 3자 구도로 대결 중이다. 후보들의 지지율이 엇비슷해 누구도 승리를 장담하기 어렵다는 여론조사 결과도 나왔다.)

◇Five-Way Race in Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek B <<> A by-election in Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek B, triggered by former Democratic Party lawmaker Lee Byung-jin receiving a ruling that nullified his election, has seen five candidates file so far. The Democratic Party nominated former lawmaker Kim Yong-nam, who moved from the People Power Party to the Rebuilding Korea Party before joining the Democratic Party last year, while the People Power Party nominated former three-term lawmaker Yoo Ui-dong from Pyeongtaek. Also running are Cho Kuk, leader of the Rebuilding Korea Party, Kim Jae-yeon, co-chair of the Progressive Party, and Hwang Kyo-ahn, leader of Liberty and Innovation. <<> In a poll conducted by the Korea Society Opinion Institute (KSOI) on the 25th and 26th at the request of Pressian, candidate Cho Kuk received 23.4%, Kim Yong-nam 21.4%, and Yoo Ui-dong 21.2%, all within the margin of error (±3.7 percentage points). Candidates Hwang Kyo-ahn and Kim Jae-yeon also garnered significant support at 12% and 9.4%, respectively. <<> Within the pan-opposition bloc, the Progressive Party has already argued for an "electoral alliance of five democratic reform and progressive parties," demanding candidate unification. A Progressive Party official said, "With Kim Jae-yeon showing meaningful support, our push for an alliance has gained momentum." Candidates Kim Yong-nam and Cho Kuk have also left the door open to unification. In a radio interview on the 28th, Kim said, "If there seems to be a significant chance of victory, we could begin serious discussions." Cho stated on the 27th, "Solidarity among progressive and reform parties is essential." A Democratic Party official noted, "If the five-way race continues, Kim Yong-nam might win, but with Yoo Ui-dong having built a considerable local base and possibly uniting with former Prime Minister Hwang Kyo-ahn, the outcome is hard to guarantee." <<> Regarding the possibility of unification with Hwang Kyo-ahn, Yoo Ui-dong said, "In elections, you can't be certain," but added, "Personally, I think the likelihood is close to zero." In a phone call with this newspaper, Hwang said, "I will do everything possible for the right wing to win," adding, "I previously oversaw a conservative grand coalition when I led the Liberty Korea Party," leaving room for unification. <<> An opposition source commented, "If progressive unification materializes, the situation could change. An early variable is how much Yoo Ui-dong can consolidate conservative votes." <<> ◇Three-Way Race in Busan North A <<> In the by-election for Busan North A, triggered by Democratic Party lawmaker Jeon Jae-soo running for Busan mayor, former presidential secretary for AI future planning Ha Jeong-woo is expected to run as the Democratic Party candidate. On the conservative side, unification between the People Power Party candidate and former leader Han Dong-hoon, who declared an independent run, is a variable. In a poll conducted by News Tomato and Media Tomato on the 24th and 25th, former secretary Ha received 35.5%, former leader Han 28.5%, and former Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Park Min-sik 26%. <<> In response to calls for unification, former Minister Park said to this newspaper, "Demanding unification is an insult to the residents. There is a 0% chance of unification." Former leader Han stated, "Before the greater cause of 'saving conservatism,' political engineering will become largely meaningless. Everyone who agrees with the 'southeast wind theory' of conservative reconstruction should gather on one path." <<> Within and outside the party, there is talk that "while the leadership under Jang Dong-hyuk is negative about unification, as the election approaches, pressure for unification will inevitably grow." Within the pro-Han faction of the People Power Party, there were calls for "no nomination" by not fielding a candidate, but a significant number of party lawmakers in Busan are advocating for "conservative unification." Former National Assembly Speaker Chung Ui-hwa, appointed honorary head of the People Power Party's Busan region election committee, said at a meeting with party leader Jang Dong-hyuk last year, "There's no reason not to join forces with former leader Han." (◇5파전 경기 평택을)

item.title: Song Eon-seok: "Introducing a Special Counsel with Prosecution Dismissal Powers is a Clear Violation of the Rule of Law and Judicial Destruction" (송언석 “與 공소취소 특검 도입, 명백한 법치 유린이자 사법 파괴”)
item.description:
Song Eon-seok: "Introducing a Special Counsel with Prosecution Dismissal Powers is a Clear Violation of the Rule of Law and Judicial Destruction" (송언석 “與 공소취소 특검 도입, 명백한 법치 유린이자 사법 파괴”)

Song Eon-seok, the floor leader of the People Power Party, stated on the 30th regarding the Democratic Party of Korea's consideration of granting a special counsel for the 'alleged fabricated indictment case' the authority to dismiss prosecutions, saying, "Introducing a special counsel with prosecution dismissal powers is a clear violation of the rule of law and an act of judicial destruction." (송언석 국민의힘 원내대표는 더불어민주당이 ‘조작기소 의혹 사건’ 특검에 공소 취소 권한을 주는 것을 검토하는 데 대해 “공소취소 특검 도입은 명백한 법치 유린이자 사법 파괴 행위”라고 30일 말했다.)

At a Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly that day, Floor Leader Song said, "I say this clearly. Even if the sky splits in two, Lee Jae-myung is guilty." (송 원내대표는 이날 국회에서 열린 최고위원회의에서 “분명히 말한다. 하늘이 두 쪽이 나도 이재명은 유죄”라며 이같이 말했다.)

Floor Leader Song added, "The Democratic Party of Korea, while continuing to throw tantrums, is moving on to the next step of a special counsel with prosecution dismissal powers," and "It intends to hand over the sword of a self-pardon, in the form of the power to dismiss prosecutions related to President Lee's cases, to a special counsel appointed by President Lee Jae-myung." (송 원내대표는 “더불어민주당은 계속 생떼를 쓰면서 공소취소 특검이라는 다음 스텝으로 넘어가고 있다”면서 “이재명 대통령​이 임명하는 특검에게 이 대통령 관련 사건의 공소취소권이라고 하는 셀프 사면의 칼을 쥐어주겠다는 것”이라고 말했다.)

Floor Leader Song stated, "This parliamentary investigation was, in a word, a self-destructive investigation to prove Lee Jae-myung's guilt," and "Though it began with unconstitutionality and illegality, and the process was marked by barbarism and violence, the result was a revelation of truth that proved to the entire world that 'Lee Jae-myung is guilty.'" He continued, "There was no manipulation or inducement, only lies from the Daejang-dong gang, including Lee Hwa-young and Kim Man-bae." (송 원내대표는 “이번 국정조사는 한마디로 이재명 유죄 입증 자폭 국정조사였다”면서 “시작은 위헌과 위법이었고, 과정은 야만과 폭력이었지만 결과는 ‘이재명은 유죄’라는 것을 만천하에 증명한 진실 규명이었다”고 했다. 이어 “(민주당이 주장하는) 조작과 회유는 없었고 이화영, 김만배 등 대장동 일당의 거짓말만 있었을 뿐”이라고 했다.)

People Power Party lawmaker Na Kyung-won also criticized the move in a Facebook post that day, saying, "The Democratic Party is now reportedly pushing forward with a 'Lee Jae-myung guilt-erasure special counsel law.'" (나경원 국민의힘 의원도 이날 페이스북 글에서 “민주당이 이젠 아예 ‘이재명 죄지우기 특검법’을 밀어붙인다고 한다”고 비판했다.)

Lawmaker Na stated, "A special counsel can never have the power to dismiss a prosecution," and "The subject of a special counsel's investigation is solely whether the investigative agency manipulated the case; the seven cases, including the Daejang-dong case, are the main cases that serve as the premise. The dismissal of prosecutions for these seven cases is an exclusive authority that only the prosecutors of the prosecution office that initially indicted them can exercise." (나 의원은 “특검은 결코 공소취소 권한을 가질 수 없다”면서 “특검의 수사 대상은 수사 기관의 조작 여부일 뿐, 대장동 등 7대 사건은 그 전제가 되는 본안 사건이다. 7대 사건의 공소취소는 당초 이를 기소한 검찰청 검사만이 할 수 있는 고유 권한”이라고 했다.)

Lawmaker Na said, "A special counsel investigator, who did not even file the indictment, arbitrarily dismissing a prosecution is a clear unconstitutionality that outright seizes the judiciary's authority to determine guilt or innocence, and an act of destroying the judicial system," and "Ultimately, this means using the president's power to unilaterally dismiss the prosecution in his own trial." She added, "If they continue to mobilize all power to erase guilt and deceive the people by pretending to be innocent like this, they will face the people's judgment in the June 3 local elections." (나 의원은 “기소하지도 않은 특검 검사가 자의적으로 공소를 취소한다는 것은 사법부의 유무죄 판단 권한을 통째로 강탈하는 명백한 위헌이자 사법 체계 파괴 행위”라면서 “결국 대통령의 힘으로 본인 재판의 공소를 스스로 취소하겠다는 것”이라고 했다. 이어 “이대로 권력을 총동원해 죄를 지우고 깨끗한 척 국민을 기만하려 든다면, 6·3 지방선거에서 국민의 심판을 받게 될 것”이라고 했다.)

As the National Assembly's parliamentary investigation into the 'alleged manipulation and indictment cases by the Yoon Seok-yeol regime's political prosecutors'—led by the Democratic Party—concluded that day, the Democratic Party has announced it will push for a special counsel. It is reported that members of the Democratic Party's special parliamentary investigation committee are strongly considering including a provision in the draft that would allow the special counsel to dismiss prosecutions in ongoing trials. (민주당이 주도해온 국회 ‘윤석열 정권 정치검찰 조작기소 의혹 사건 국정조사’ 활동이 이날 종료되는 가운데, 민주당은 특검을 추진하겠다고 밝히고 있다. 민주당 국조특위 위원들은 특검이 진행 중인 재판의 공소 취소를 할 수 있도록 하는 조항을 초안에 담는 방안을 유력 검토 중인 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: Ha Jung-woo's 'Hand-Shake Wipe' Controversy... Opposition: "Treats Busan Residents' Hands as Filth" (하정우, 악수 후 손털기 논란... 野 “부산 주민 손 오물 취급”)
item.description:
Ha Jung-woo, former presidential secretary for AI future strategy at the Blue House and candidate in the Busan Buk-gu by-election, faced a joint attack on the 30th from former Minister Park Min-shik of the People Power Party (PPP) and independent former leader Han Dong-hoon, amid controversy over his so-called 'hand-wiping after a handshake.' <<> The previous day, Ha was filmed at the Gupo Market in Buk-gu, Busan, repeatedly shaking or wiping his hands after shaking hands with local merchants, sparking controversy. <<> Former Minister Park wrote on his Facebook page: "The hands of the mothers at Gupo Market are not 'filth' to be wiped away, but 'medals of honor' that raised us. The hearts of the residents who saw that video are now being torn apart." He added, "It was an unconscious outburst of a deep-seated sense of entitlement and arrogance, treating residents who have spent a lifetime building this community as a 'different class' that can never mix with him." <<> Independent former leader Han appeared on KBS Radio that day and stated, "There were several scenes that cast doubt on whether he was truly meeting those people with sincerity and humility." He later posted on his Facebook page: "I saw a Democratic Party deputy spokesperson on a broadcast say, 'Ha Jung-woo's hand-wiping doesn't affect the trend.' Is it the Democratic Party's view that ignoring Buk-gu citizens doesn't affect the trend?" <<> Criticism also poured in from within the PPP. Supreme Council member Kim Jae-won said at a party meeting that day: "Yesterday, after shaking hands with a few young merchants at the market, Ha suddenly wiped his hand as if it had been contaminated with filth. Ha Jung-woo treats voters like insects." <<> Lawmaker Kim Jae-seop appeared on Channel A's YouTube channel and said, "Shaking hands with residents and then wiping his hand—it was shocking, a terrible scene. It looks extremely arrogant for President Lee to have sent out someone lacking basic political manners." <<> Spokesperson Cho Yong-sool issued a statement, asking: "One cannot help but ask whether he wiped his hand the same way after shaking hands with powerful figures like President Lee Jae-myung and Representative Jung Cheong-rae. Politics that mimic aristocracy after rising up can never win voters' approval." (부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 출마 예정인 하정우 전 청와대 AI미래기획수석의 이른바 ‘악수 후 손 털기’ 논란에 이 지역에 출마하는 국민의힘 소속 박민식 전 장관과 무소속 한동훈 전 대표가 30일 일제히 협공에 나섰다.)

item.title: Democratic Party Recruits Former Vice Minister of Oceans and Fisheries Kim Seong-beom… Likely to Run in Seogwipo, Jeju (민주당, 김성범 전 해수부 차관 영입…제주 서귀포 출마 유력)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea recruited former Vice Minister of Oceans and Fisheries Kim Seong-beom as its third talent for the June 3 by-election for the National Assembly. Kim, who hails from Seogwipo, Jeju, is widely expected to run in the Seogwipo district, where a by-election is being held following the candidacy of lawmaker Wi Seong-gon for Jeju governor. (더불어민주당은 30일 김성범 전 해양수산부 차관을 6·3 국회의원 재보궐선거 3호 인재로 영입했다. 제주 서귀포 출신인 김 전 차관은 위성곤 의원의 제주도지사 출마로 보궐선거가 치러지는 서귀포 지역구 출마가 유력하다.)

At a talent recruitment ceremony held at the National Assembly that day, Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae described former Vice Minister Kim as "the top expert in maritime and fisheries administration" and said he was "like a hometown love coupon." He added, "Former Vice Minister Kim was born in Seogwipo, Jeju, and attended elementary, middle, and high schools all in Seogwipo. He is a pride of Seogwipo and a true son of Seogwipo." (정청래 민주당 대표는 이날 국회에서 열린 인재영입식에서 김 전 차관을 “해양수산 행정의 최고 전문가”라며 “고향사랑상품권 같은 사람”이라고 했다. 정 대표는 그러면서 “김 전 차관은 제주 서귀포에서 태어나 초중고 모두 서귀포에서 나온 서귀포의 자랑이자 서귀포의 진짜 아들”이라고 했다.)

Former Vice Minister Kim said, "I stand here with a heart to now use the state affairs experience and strength built over 32 years for my hometown of Seogwipo." (김 전 차관은 “32년간 쌓아온 국정 경험과 힘을 이제 고향 서귀포를 위해 쓰겠다는 마음으로 이 자리에 섰다”고 했다.)

When asked, "You experienced both progressive and conservative ideologies during your 32-year public service career, so why did you choose the Democratic Party?" Kim replied, "I agree with the state affairs philosophy of the Yoon Suk Yeol government, and for nearly a year, I have worked to implement those state tasks. I made this decision for the success of the Yoon Suk Yeol government." (김 전 차관은 ‘32년 공직 생활을 하며 진보와 보수를 경험했는데 왜 민주당을 선택했느냐’는 질문에 “이재명 정부 국정철학에 동의해 그 국정과제를 이행하려고 지난 1년 가까이 노력했다”며 “이재명 정부 성공을 위해 결정했다”고 했다.)

Regarding the Seogwipo Second Airport issue, he said, "I agree on the need for airport facility expansion, but I am also well aware of the various concerns. I will organize those issues well and discuss specific methods or procedures separately within the region." (그는 서귀포 제2공항 문제에 대해선 “공항 시설 확충 필요성은 공감하나 여러 걱정이 있는 것도 잘 안다”며 “그런 사안을 잘 정리해 구체적 방법이나 절차는 별도로 지역에서 말하겠다”고 했다.)

Former Vice Minister Kim graduated from Jeju Seogwipo High School and earned a degree in Public Administration from Korea University. After passing the Higher Civil Service Examination, he entered public service in 1994. At the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, he served as Director of Maritime Policy and Director of the Maritime Policy Office. He also served as acting minister until last month after Democratic Party Busan mayoral candidate Jeon Jae-su resigned as Minister of Oceans and Fisheries amid allegations of receiving money from the Unification Church at the end of last year. (김 전 차관은 제주 서귀포고, 고려대 행정학과를 졸업했다. 행정고시에 합격해 1994년 공직에 입문했고 해수부에서 해양정책관, 해양정책실장 등을 역임했다. 전재수 민주당 부산시장 후보가 작년 말 통일교 금품 수수 의혹으로 해수부 장관에서 사퇴한 뒤 지난달까지 장관 직무를 대행하기도 했다.)
